business_problem: Addepar needed a better way to support investment data unification, client onboarding, and advisor analytics because rapid growth in assets under management made disparate datasets and long pipeline lead times too slow for large institutional onboarding.
solution_summary: Addepar uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support investment data unification, client onboarding, and advisor analytics. The implementation replaced a legacy state where rapid growth in assets under management made disparate datasets and long pipeline lead times too slow for large institutional onboarding. Portfolio data and market data feeds move through Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, Genie, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver client onboarding pipelines and investment analytics.
business_outcome: Addepar improved investment data unification, client onboarding, and advisor analytics with measurable results including 5x connecting the global investment ecosystem, $2M faster pipeline development, accelerating client onboarding, and 200% saved with data infrastructure optimization, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: $2M faster pipeline development, accelerating client onboarding
